enhancement.definition: The principal owes statutory indemnity and compensation protections to an agent acting within lawful authority or in good faith under the agency.
enhancement.legalPrinciple: Sections 222–225 protect the agent against consequences of lawful acts and good-faith acts done within authority and provide compensation where the principal’s neglect causes injury to the agent.
essentialIngredients: Establish the agency and the agent’s authority.
Determine whether the act was lawful and within authority or done in good faith.
Identify the consequence suffered by the agent.
For section 225, connect the injury to the principal’s neglect or want of skill.
enhancement.detailedExplanation:
India Code rule: Sections 222–225 protect the agent against consequences of lawful acts and good-faith acts done within authority and provide compensation where the principal’s neglect causes injury to the agent.

Definition: The principal owes statutory indemnity and compensation protections to an agent acting within lawful authority or in good faith under the agency.

Ingredients:
1. Establish the agency and the agent’s authority.
2. Determine whether the act was lawful and within authority or done in good faith.
3. Identify the consequence suffered by the agent.
4. For section 225, connect the injury to the principal’s neglect or want of skill.
